title: Math 321 – Differential Equations
text:
The Lorenz System
The curve below traces a solution to the Lorenz system:
\[
\frac{dx}{dt} = \sigma(y - x), \qquad
\frac{dy}{dt} = x(\rho - z) - y, \qquad
\frac{dz}{dt} = xy - \beta z
\]
Set the parameters and initial condition, then press start to trace the solution. Drag to rotate; scroll to zoom. Press stop at any time to explore the curve, then start again to continue. Reset clears the curve and unlocks the sliders.



  

  Select Parameters:
  
    σ (sigma)10.0
    ρ (rho)28.0
    β (beta)2.7
  

  Select Initial Condition:
  
    x₀1.0
    y₀1.0
    z₀10.0
    
      start
      stop
      reset
    
  

  
    solution curve
    initial condition
    current position
    fixed points
  
  drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · sliders lock while animating



Classic parameters: σ = 10, ρ = 28, β = 8/3 ≈ 2.7. Try reducing ρ below 24.74 — the chaos disappears and solutions settle onto one of the fixed points.
